Alongside ximage() matching adornment functions share layout conventions: xcontour() (contours cell centres), xtext() (cell values labels), xrect() (rectangles extents). orientation “raster order”, .e. ’re looking picture ’s top left top right, scan lines row bottom (like western reading par(mfrow) order). orientation explored orientation vignette. matches way spatial data readers read imagery, equivalent populating R matrix matrix(<>, nrow, ncol, byrow = TRUE) (note backwards order nrow,ncol). Please note getting data matrix order, .vector(t(m)). Higher dimensional arrays need care, ’s byrow array(). full story package vignette: vignette("orientation", package = "ximage").

title: ximage - draw images of raster data
text: basic example shows image topographic dataset, arbitrary image overlay placement.    Missing values constant transparency first-class: ocean set missing displays na.col, RGB overlay applied constant alpha.  can get imagery internet, plot quickly.
code: library(ximage) ximage(topo)  ## plot in the index space of the matrix ## or, plot in the geographic space (we happen to know this for this matrix) ximage(topo, extent = c(-180, 180, -90, 90), axes = FALSE) ximage(logo_a, extent = c(170, 180, -40, -30), add = TRUE)  axis(1); axis(2); box() ximage(logo_a)  ## plot a RGB array, a new plot in its own index space ## overlay a native raster, and a matrix with its own palette ximage(logo_n, extent = c(10, 20, 20, 40), add = TRUE) ximage(topo, extent = c(40, 60, 30, 50), add = TRUE, col = hcl.colors(256)) land <- topo land[land < 0] <- NA ximage(topo, extent = c(-180, 180, -90, 90), col = hcl.colors(64, "Blues 3")) ximage(land, extent = c(-180, 180, -90, 90), add = TRUE,        col = hcl.colors(64, "Terrain 2")) ximage(logo_a, extent = c(-60, 60, -80, -35), add = TRUE, alpha = 0.5) library(vapour)   virtual_earth <-  "<GDAL_WMS><Service name=\"VirtualEarth\"><ServerUrl>http://a${server_num}.ortho.tiles.virtualearth.net/tiles/a${quadkey}.jpeg?g=90</ServerUrl></Service><MaxConnections>4</MaxConnections><Cache/></GDAL_WMS>" par(mar = rep(0, 4)) px <- dev.size("px") px[which.min(px)] <- 0  ## zero means GDAL fills this dimension, preserving aspect  ## change lon_0 and lat_0 to anywhere you like im <- gdal_raster_nara(virtual_earth, target_ext = c(-1, 1, -1, 1) * 3e5, target_dim = px, target_crs = "+proj=laea +lon_0=147 +lat_0=-42")  system.time(ximage(im, asp = 1)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.004   0.000   0.003   ## crank up the size it's still fast px <- px * 4 im <- gdal_raster_nara(virtual_earth, target_ext = c(-1, 1, -1, 1) * 3e5, target_dim = px, target_crs = "+proj=laea +lon_0=147 +lat_0=-42")  system.time(ximage(im, asp = 1)) #>    user  system elapsed  #>   0.046   0.018   0.065

title: Plot an image — ximage
text: ximage() combination graphics function best features one. Allow arrays RGB/. Allow matrix character (named colours, hex) raw (Byte) values Allow list output vapour gdalraster, list numeric values, hex character, nativeRaster Plot 0,ncol 0,nrow default Override default extent (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) Allow general numeric values. Start plot scratch without setting plot paint . Plot default 0,ncol,0,nrow unspecified. Data orientation "raster order", first cell top-left displayed image, following scan lines page (see package vignette orientation). Bare atomic vectors (dim, 'gis' attribute gdalraster, width/height/depth attributes) accepted dimension guessed integer-division detection vector length. nearly square factorization chosen (preferring landscape, ncol >= nrow) data assumed raster scanline order, .e. flat output GDAL readers vapour::gdal_raster_data() gdalraster::read_ds(), built matrix(x, ncol = NC, byrow = TRUE); column-major R data needs dim(x) <- c(NR, NC) instead. message reports guess candidate factorizations 1xN Nx1, GDAL dimension order (ncol x nrow, xsize x ysize). Raw vectors also consider 3-plane (RGB) 4-plane (RGBA) scanline pixel-interleaved interpretations; numeric data never gets plane interpretation (whole numbers 0..255 common ordinary data imply image, much narrower opt-detection may come later). long vectors (getOption("ximage.guess_max", 2^24) elements) guess stops error unless force = TRUE, set dimension explicitly. Colour mapping via 'col', 'breaks', 'zlim' applies single-band numeric data . Multi-band (grey/alpha, RGB, RGBA) data scaled automatically: values within 0,1 used -, within 0,255 divided 255, anything else rescaled finite range colour bands. Missing values (NA, NaN) display 'na.col' cases.

title: Plot an image — ximage
code: ximage(volcano)  ximage(as.raster(matrix(0:1, 49, 56)))  v <- volcano v[v > 180] <- NA ximage(v, na.col = "hotpink")   ## bare vectors in GDAL scanline order get a guessed dimension, with a ## message listing candidate shapes (ncol x nrow); here the guess 87x61 ## is the mirror of the true 61x87, so pick from the candidates ximage(as.vector(t(volcano))) #> guessing dimension for vector of length 5,307 #>   using ncol x nrow = 87 x 61 (GDAL xsize x ysize), as matrix(x, ncol = 87, byrow = TRUE) #>   candidates (ncol x nrow): 1x5307, 3x1769, 29x183, 61x87, [87x61], 183x29, 1769x3, 5307x1  ximage(matrix(as.vector(t(volcano)), ncol = 61, byrow = TRUE))

title: ximage 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-21 New vignette “ximage” frames package motivation: raster order versus image(), rasterImage() honest primitive, GDAL flat reads dimension guess, nativeRaster fast destination colour imagery. Bare atomic vectors (numeric, integer, raw, character) dim known attributes now get guessed dimension integer-division detection length, choosing nearly square factorization (landscape preferred) assuming raster scanline order, .e. flat output GDAL readers vapour::gdal_raster_data() gdalraster::read_ds(), built matrix(x, ncol = NC, byrow = TRUE) (column-major R data needs dim(x) <- c(NR, NC) instead). message reports guess candidate shapes 1xN Nx1, GDAL dimension order (ncol x nrow). Raw vectors also consider 3-plane (RGB) 4-plane (RGBA) scanline pixel-interleaved interpretations; numeric data never gets plane interpretation default. Vectors longer getOption("ximage.guess_max", 2^24) error unless force = TRUE dimension set explicitly. New function xtext() draws matrix values labels cell centres, raster-order layout used ximage() (thanks draft issue #22). Supports vapour gdalraster reader-output lists. New vignette “Array orientation: raster order R matrix” explains raster-order convention, byrow = TRUE .vector(t(m)) round trip, multi-band aperm() recipes, cell-edge extent convention (#14). Now support raw output fastpng. Now support {gdalraster} output read_ds(, as_list = TRUE) raw numeric, thanks Chris Toney. ximage() now handles breaks argument go col (numeric input). image() now works list output gdalnara (gdal_raster_image nativeRaster). Added suport xcontour() output output gdal_raster_data() {vapour}. ximage() can now plot sf::gdal_read objects. Fixed default extent array/matrix, transposed (!). ximage now imfun whatarelief , .e. output gdal_raster_data, gdal_raster_dsn, gdal_raster_image obvious plot. Add ‘mesh_plot’ mode ximage(), fully implemented. Increase default colour classes, 12 -> 96. Support ‘raster’ class per .raster. Added xcontour xrect functions.
